correctness.rationale: The proper complex Gaussian STFT for g_s is equivalent up to a nonvanishing gauge to a first-order polyanalytic Bargmann field aG+b(G′−bar(z)G). Along any physical direction u, Kac–Rice for two nearby zeros and conditional Taylor regression gives the 1/4 p_(F,Fu)(0,0) expectation of (Im(conj Fuu Fv))². Explicit ξ0–ξ3 Gaussian jets satisfy Var(Fu|F)=πD_s(θ) with D=1+2s²+2s(1-s)cos2θ>0. Conditioning F=Fu=0 reduces Fv and Fuu to independent circular Gaussian R,Z terms. Wick fourth moments produce 32s³(1-s)P²/D²+24s^4/D in the appropriately π³-scaled conditional Jacobian variance, yielding the displayed angular formula with correct physical area normalization. The conditional Z contribution forces opposite-charge contact for s>0; direct s=0,1 evaluation and uniform D=1+O(s),P=cos3θ+O(s) prove endpoints and s^-3 uniform six-lobe asymptotic. This uses analytic Gaussian regression for the contact, not numerical interpolation.
